one_liner: DealCloud (Intapp) is a CRM for financial services with a broad REST API using OAuth2 client credentials, but it is sold via sales and has no self-serve signup or trial.
auth_notes: Token endpoint uses client_credentials with client_id and a user-generated apiKey (from the user Profile), returning a 15-minute bearer token. There is no self-serve app registration or authorization-code flow for the main API. Multi-user access is done through a service account plus user proxy assignments. The MCP server uses OAuth with pre-registered clients.
access_notes: The API key is generated inside a licensed DealCloud site by a user whose group has the API capability. The docs show no free tier, trial or developer sandbox. Obtaining a site means going through an Intapp account manager or CSM.
blocker_notes: There is no public signup or sandbox. Credentials require a licensed DealCloud tenant, which is obtained through sales or an account manager.

evidence.quote: DealCloud uses the OAuth2 Client Credentials flow to generate a bearer token, which is then used in the HTTP Authentication header for API requests.
Scroll down to the API Key section and click **Enable**. Then click **Copy API Key to Clipboard** to copy your API key for use in integrations or API requests.
If you do not see the Admin section, contact your organization's admin or DealCloud Customer Success Manager (CSM) for assistance.
Get in touch with your account manager to have Publications enabled on your site.
The DealCloud API requires user-specific credentials and authentication tokens for access.
DealCloud now provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server which gives AI agents read access to your DealCloud data.
All DealCloud MCP tools are currently read-only and do not create, update, or delete data.
